req.title: Create requires title
req.statement: The system shall render 'Title is required.' when POST /create omits the title field.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-016 requires that POST /create with a missing title field renders 'Title is required.' in a 2xx response. Three test cases are designed: (1) positive — POST /create with a valid title and body succeeds (redirects, no error), confirming the happy path and that the validation branch is not always triggered; (2) negative — POST /create with title omitted (empty string) triggers the exact error message 'Title is required.' in a 2xx response; (3) boundary — POST /create with title as a single space character (whitespace-only, which is falsy after strip but the source uses `if not title` on the raw form value — a single space is truthy in Python, so it should NOT trigger the error, distinguishing the boundary between empty and non-empty). Each test sets up its own in-process Flask app with a temp DB, registers and logs in a user, then exercises the endpoint. Assertions are exact-value to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_create_with_valid_title_succeeds
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
User 'Rahul' is registered and logged in (from seed data: id=1, password='stone')
POST /create is called with non-empty title and body
actions: Initialise Flask app with temp DB and run init_db
POST /create with title='Valid Title', body='Some body text'
expected: HTTP 302 redirect (successful creation redirects to index)
Response does NOT contain 'Title is required.'
trace: R-FLASKR-016: happy path — title present, no validation error emitted
Catches mutations that always flash the error or invert the `if not title` condition
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_create_with_valid_title_succeeds():
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        sess.clear()
    r_login = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r_login.status_code == 302
    r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Valid Title', 'body': 'Some body text'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert b'Title is required.' not in r.data
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
